title: Yemen's Armed Forces Claim 356 Operations Against Houthi Targets in 24 Hours
detail: Yemen's armed forces announced 356 separate operations against Houthi targets over a single 24-hour period, indicating a significant intensification of offensive activity. The scale of reported operations suggests a major coordinated push against Houthi positions across multiple fronts, though independent verification of the full scope of these operations was not immediately available.

title: Analysts and Western Officials Urge Saudi-UAE Reconciliation to Counter Houthi and Separatist Forces
detail: Analysts and Western officials have urged Saudi Arabia to reconcile with the UAE as a precondition for driving back Houthi and separatist forces, underscoring continuing fractures within the anti-Houthi coalition. The call highlights persistent tensions between Riyadh and Abu Dhabi that have undermined coordinated military strategy in Yemen, with observers warning that coalition disunity remains a key obstacle to reversing Houthi territorial gains.
